title: achillea nobilis subsp. ligustica
intro: Achillea nobilis subsp. ligustica, commonly known as the Ligustic Yarrow or Italian Yarrow, is a subspecies of the yarrow plant native to the Mediterranean region. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from inflammation, pain, and digestive issues due to its various health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Achillea nobilis subsp. ligustica include anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and antiseptic effects, making it a popular choice for treating wounds, fever, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, sesquiterpene lactones, and volatile oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
